attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file RI state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "RI Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "RI" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "RI" streq } over if

action_details.action_postfix:
# RI filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). # # Reference: RI Form RI-1120C Instructions (Corporate Income Tax Return) # Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-2 (Tax imposed) # Reference: RI Division of Taxation Regulation CT 17-01 (Nexus Standards)
"RI filing required - physical nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

# RI filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). # Threshold: $100,000 in gross receipts from Rhode Island sources or 200 transactions. # # Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) # Reference: RI Division of Taxation Regulation SU 17-21 (Economic Nexus) # Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-1 (Definitions and nexus standards)
"RI filing required - economic nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "RI - no nexus, no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate RI state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "RI Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus with RI; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate RI state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "RI income adjustments calculated. Additions may include: Interest on U.S. government obligations, IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction, Federal bonus depreciation not allowed by RI. Subtractions may include: Interest on Rhode Island state and municipal obligations, Capital gains on certain qualified Rhode Island investments, Rhode Island net operating loss deduction. Reference: RI Form RI-1120C Instructions, R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-11" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"RI - no nexus, no adjustments" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate RI state corporate income tax. Applies 7% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "RI State Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus with RI; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate RI tax at 7% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.ri_state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "RI tax calculated at 7% flat rate. Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-2" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "RI - nexus but no taxable income. RI NOL carryforward rules may apply. Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-11" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "RI - no nexus, no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto
